articleTitle: What to Ask a Parent With Dementia While They Can Still Talk
imageHeadline: Questions to ask before aphasia takes her words
imageSubtext: What to capture now while your parent can still speak
pinTitle: What to Ask a Parent With Dementia While They Can Still Talk | Primary Progressive Aphasia
pinDescription: Primary progressive aphasia will eventually take your mother's ability to speak and understand language. From her own story to messages for future milestones, here are the categories of questions that matter most when conversation is on a timeline.

items.label: Her story in her words—childhood, becoming a mother, what she was like at your age
Practical details you'll need—recipes, passwords, family history you don't know yet
Messages for specific moments—your wedding, a hard day, advice for a grandchild

backgroundScene: A small audio recorder resting on a kitchen table beside two cups of tea, soft afternoon light coming through a window
